That lasted until 2016 when ADUs became a permitted use, meaning that they're permitted with subject to conditions. There also used to be an occupancy limitation limiting ADU residents to seniors or to disabled people.

City Council removed that provision last year. Now, detached accessory dwelling units didn't just pop up out of last year's work sessions. Like we had talked about in May, the subtlety from a policy perspective is that this is a balancing act.
